title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by the other Binderscope schemas. Numbering is UniProt numbering unless a field says otherwise. Coordinates are Angstrom in the reference frame of the target (docs/data_contract.md section 2).

resi.description: Residue number in UniProt numbering (the numbering of the full-length protein).

resi_list.description: Residue numbers, UniProt numbering, ascending unless a field says otherwise.

xyz.description: One point [x, y, z] in Angstrom.

flat_xyz.description: Flattened coordinates [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, ...]. Length is a multiple of 3 (checked by scripts/validate_schema.py, JSON Schema cannot express it).

transform12.description: Rigid transform: 9 numbers of a row-major rotation R followed by 3 of a translation t. A point x maps to R x + t.

emb2.description: Position on the 2-D map, both coordinates in 0..1.

residue_code.description: Amino-acid code of one residue. New exports write one letter; older data holds three-letter codes in target.resn, which the viewer must keep accepting.

binder_sequence.description: One-letter binder sequence. A binder of several chains - an scFv's VH and VL, a homo-oligomer's copies - has its chains separated by "/", which is how BindCraft writes Binder_Sequence. Readers that want one string remove the separator; anything that orders or synthesises the molecule needs the chains apart.

ss_string.description: Secondary structure, one letter per residue: H helix, E strand, L everything else.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, UTC unless an offset is given.

key_id.description: Identifier used as an object key or a reference (design id, run id, mode id, site id).

filter_failure.description: One failed filter of a rejected (or accepted-with-failed-model) design. Mirrors binder_review.config.FilterFailure.

stem.description: BindCraft metric stem, e.g. Surface_Hydrophobicity, or InterfaceAAs_K.

metric.description: Key of the page metric in design.m that carries the same quantity, or null when the page has none.

scope.description: 'Average' or the model number as a string ('1', '2').

value.description: The design's value, in the CSV scale.

op.description: The value must satisfy value op threshold to pass.

gap.description: How far the value misses the threshold, in the metric's own unit.

rel.description: gap / max(|threshold|, 1e-9): the miss as a share of the threshold. Used to rank near-misses. Null when the miss is not measured (measured false).

reported.description: Only for a run judged by the thresholds it recorded itself: true when BindCraft named this filter in failed_filters, false when it was found here from the CSV mean (BindCraft stops at the first validation model that fails).

measured.description: Only for a run judged by the thresholds it recorded itself: false when BindCraft judged the filter on one validation model and the CSV mean does not show the miss (scope Model, gap 0.0 is a lower bound, rel is null).
